acquisition method: Twenty tandem mass spectra were collected in a data-dependent manner following each survey scan.
cleavage agent: followed by trypsin digestion and peptide desalting.
collision energy: Normalized collision energy was set at 27
Normalized collision energy was set at 27.
enrichment method: Biotinylated proteins were recovered using neutravidin beads
fractionation method: The flow-through peptides were separated with high pH reversed-phase offline fractionation cartridges into four fractions for protein identification.
instrument: A nanoflow ultra high-performance liquid chromatograph interfaced with an electrospray benchtop Orbitrap mass spectrometer (RSLCnano and Q Exactive HF-X, Thermo Fisher Scientific) was used for LC/MS-MS peptide sequencing experiments.
ionization type: A nanoflow ultra high-performance liquid chromatograph interfaced with an electrospray benchtop Orbitrap mass spectrometer (RSLCnano and Q Exactive HF-X, Thermo Fisher Scientific) was used for LC/MS-MS peptide sequencing experiments.
labeling: Cleaned peptides were labeled with TMT10plex isobaric labeling reagent (90110, Thermo Fisher Scientific) for multiplexing.
mass analyzer: A nanoflow ultra high-performance liquid chromatograph interfaced with an electrospray benchtop Orbitrap mass spectrometer (RSLCnano and Q Exactive HF-X, Thermo Fisher Scientific) was used for LC/MS-MS peptide sequencing experiments.
ptm: fixed Carbamidomethyl cysteine; variable Biotin-HPDP labeling of cysteine; variable methionine oxidation
Carbamidomethyl cysteine was set as a fixed modification. Biotin-HPDP labeling of cysteine and methionine oxidation were set as variable modifications.
